title: 1977 AHSME Problem 8
statement: For every triple \((a,b,c)\) of nonzero real numbers, form the number \[ \frac a{|a|}+\frac b{|b|}+\frac c{|c|}+\frac{abc}{|abc|}. \] The set of all numbers formed is

solutions.text:
Let \(r,\) \(s,\) \(t\in\{-1,1\}\) be the signs of \(a,\) \(b,\) \(c.\) The expression is \(r+s+t+rst.\) If all three signs are positive it is \(4,\) and if all are negative it is \(-4.\) If the signs are mixed, direct cancellation gives \(0.\) Hence the set is \(\{-4,0,4\}.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Each of the first three fractions is either \(1\) or \(-1\)
The sign of the final fraction is the product of the first three signs
